name: certification-workshop
description: Create, develop, launch and maintain certification programs with connected evidence and existing tools.

interface.shortDescription: Build and run a certification program
interface.longDescription: Start a certification from a brief, build job and competency models, develop a blueprint and assessment bank, coordinate review and pilot analysis, prepare launch materials, reconcile operational records, and maintain versions. Works in your existing assistant with local records and helpers. No hosted service or automatic credential issuance. Generated artifacts are drafts; expert decisions and real evidence remain explicit.
